The Academy on Instagram: "Where it all began… watch this year’s nominees react to the news that they’ve been nominated for an Oscar!

Watch the 98th #Oscars TONIGHT at 7e/4p on ABC and Hulu. #OnlyAtTheOscars"
content.text: Where it all began… watch this year’s nominees react to the news that they’ve been nominated for an Oscar!Watch the 98th #Oscars TONIGHT at 7e/4p on ABC and Hulu. #OnlyAtTheOscarsIt has been two weeks since the internet was shut down in Iran.Millions of people are isolated from the world, unable to communicate or share what is happening.The world must not ignore this.Dear Actors and actresses I’m asking you to please put political interests and preferences aside for the sake of people’s lives, and speak about the killings in Iran and the internet shutdown.This war is not a war against the people of Iran.It is a war against the Islamic Republic, a regime that for 47 years has been massacring its own people and spending the country’s wealth on terrorist groups.Please talk about the internet shutdown. This regime has cut the internet for 90 million Iranians and it is only connected for government supporters so they can spread lies everywhere.Please stand on the right side of history. #digitalblackoutiranIf the internet were cut off for more than 2 weeks in a country outside the Middle East, the world would be in chaos over the news.Iran is in the middle of a war, the criminal regime of Iran has shut down the internet and people are cut off from critical information about unsafe areas while facing threats from the regime. Their lives are at risk, yet the world remains largely silent. As George Orwell wrote in “Animal Farm” : “All animals are equal, but some animals are more equal than others.” … #DigitalBlackOutIranA country is bleeding. Its people have lived through war, fear, and a prolonged internet blackout, cut off from the world while their voices disappear into silence. Yet the world still has more to say about the Oscars than about Iran.#digitalblackoutiranThe criminal regime of Iran has shut down the internet for more than 2 weeks in the middle of a war. The people of Iran are completely cut off from the internet. They need access to evacuation alerts and uncensored information. #DigitalBlackoutIranPlease be Iranian Voice! They need Internet Access because the Government blocked their access !!!! #digitalblackoutiranone day it's gonna be my movie and my name on the nominees.Please use the opportunity of this program to speak about the millions of Iranians whose internet access has been shut down nationwide by Iran’s criminal regime for more than two weeks. Let the world not forget them.#DigitalBlackoutIranThe internet in Iran has been completely shut down for more than 15 days.Millions of people are cut off from the world. We cannot contact our families, we cannot access news, and we don’t even know where missiles might strike or what is happening around us.This is terrifying and isolating. People are living in fear and darkness.Please speak about Iran.Please help bring attention to what is happening.The world needs to hearWhile the world celebrates cinema tonight, millions of Iranians are living in a digital blackout. The internet has been largely shut down, isolating people from the world and preventing them from sharing what is happening inside the country.Please don’t forget Iran. Amplify Iranian voices and stand with a nation fighting for freedom and the right to be heard. #Iran #DigitalBlackout #FreeIranDear all this is not War, its military help to Iran! 🆘The criminal regime in Iran has shut down the internet, isolating 90 million people and putting their lives at risk.While the world watches the Oscars, civilians cannot receive emergency alerts.#DigitalBlackoutlran@theacademy Genews avanityfair @peopleChollywoodreporter@foxnews Babcnews @skynews GreutersCadê as imagens do povo do Brasil?!For the past two weeks, due to military operations in Iran, the Islamic Republic regime has cut off internet access. People in Iran have no way to communicate with the global internet. This is a serious violation of basic human rights. #DigitalBlackoutIran
